text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm Air Shakur. Just to be clear, I'm not
expecting
anything from you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong, I'll hear out any
advice you have, but I'll be the one
calling the shots. Make
sure to get that
into your head.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and if you get in my way, for any
reason at
all, I'm ending our contract
right there on the
spot. Got that? Good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
